$comment: Captured from keel/runtime/timeline.ts of commit 66d659e, the last TypeScript model, with one read-only getter added to Timeline (`get entries() { return this.#entries; }`), by the script in `capture`: save it as keel/runtime/capture-projection.ts in that tree and run `bun keel/runtime/capture-projection.ts` from the shield directory. Each step lists the entries that changed, in the driver's Entry form, `order` when an entry was not appended, and what Timeline.publish returned: every item, the ids of changed items, and whether the order changed. Tool extras are the decorator's results the old projection computed.
